task.title: To clone a template from an existing template

step.cmd: Connect to X-Author Contracts and from the left navigation panel, select X-Author Templates.
In the X-Author Templates pane, go to the Work tab, click the more icon and select Clone.
Click Clone on the X-Author Templates ribbon in Microsoft Word.

In the Clone Template page, change the name of the cloned template, to suit your requirements. By default, the cloned template name has 'Copy' added to the end of the original template name. For example, if you're cloning a template named Clause Agreement Template then the default name for the cloned template will be Clause Agreement Template Copy. You can edit the values of the other template properties too.
Click Save to save the cloned template in Contract Management.
